title: CalendarNotification
description: Notification POSTed by the calendar side to {BUS_URL}/webhooks/calendar when a poll of the Ambiguous calendar surfaces something worth texting about. The bus dedups on id and never sees Ambiguous fields -- this is the normalized shape.

id.description: source-unique id (Ambiguous reminder id or event id); dedup key

triggerAt.description: when the reminder was due; null for change notifications

detectedAt.description: when the poller saw it, ISO-8601
